interpretation: Byte-identical R4 executable copies show lower executable-file-backed residency in all three interrupted snapshot pairs. Thus the earlier small-workload RSS gap cannot be attributed solely to source changes. The kernel/page-cache cause is not established; native RSS is still real for each named artifact. This diagnostic does not measure lifetime peak or output parity.
